==Description==
'''Shield Health''' is additional health applied to some enemies.

==Mechanics==
'''Shield Health''' is a statistic that provides enemies with extra health which does not generate cash when damaged. This additional health is represented by a yellow bar on the enemy's health bar. Typically, shield health once depleted will result in an enemy's ability with specific effects. For instance, the [[Fallen Shield]] increases its speed after losing all of its shield health, or the [[Possessed Armor]] becomes hidden upon losing its shield health. It is also often used to boost the health of enemies over time with [[Mutation]].

'''Shield Health''' is not affected by [[Bloated]] nor health scale from any certain gamemode.

==Update History==
*'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]]
**'''Shield Health''' added.
**{{Bug}} '''Shield Health''' causes issues with targeting.
**{{Bug}} Damage dealt to '''Shield Health''' will break if the damage dealt is equal or higher to an enemy's '''Shield Health'''. Issues include bypassing '''Shield Health''' through collisions or damage not being tracked.
*'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]
**Damage dealt to '''Shield Health''' is now carried over to regular health when damage dealt is higher than '''Shield Health'''.
*'''13 May 2022''' - [[V1.2.2]]
**'''Shield Health''' now deals damage to base health.
**{{Bugfix}} '''Shield Health''' no longer causes issues with targeting.
*'''18 May 2024''' - [[v1.22.0]]
**'''Shield Health''' no longer deals damage to base health.
